note: Campground in the Whitemud Creek ravine in southwest Edmonton, on the river valley trail system; mostly treed sites plus three comfort-camping domes. Some power sites are 30 A (most 15 A); check the site listing. Rig length includes the tow vehicle. Overnight camping only, no day use; one adult 21+ per site. Bridge construction on the adjacent Whitemud Freeway, including overnight, runs until 2027. --Claude
